title: Google Workspace ↔ Intune Third-Party EMM Integration for Managed Google Play
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Android implementation).

Intune admin center / Microsoft Graph / managed Google Play / Google Admin console authored at exact detail from Microsoft & Google public docs. The Android Management API (AMAPI) transition, web/account-driven enrollment, and whether a change triggers device RE-ENROLLMENT are actively evolving — cited or flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance / your tenant', never asserted from memory or invented. OEM (Samsung Knox/Zebra) + third-party apps at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (Graph); no hardcoded credentials/secrets. No client names.
hook: Integrate Google Workspace with Intune as third-party EMM — without surprise re-enrollments
problem: If your users have Google Workspace / Cloud Identity accounts, connecting managed Google Play to Intune is a different integration than the standard account-enterprise bind — and teams rightly worry it will re-enroll existing devices. This solution walks the Google Workspace ↔ Intune third-party EMM integration end to end: the Google Admin console side (enable a third-party Android EMM provider), the Intune side, the identity/account model, and a clear read on enrollment/re-enrollment impact and end-user experience — so you enable it confidently.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Google Workspace ↔ Intune third-party EMM model (vs the account-enterprise bind), how managed Google Play is delegated, and the identity/account implications.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Google Workspace/Cloud Identity super-admin, Intune admin, the binding-model decision, endpoints).

Implementation Guide — configure the Google Admin console third-party EMM integration, complete the Intune side, validate account add + app delivery, and assess re-enrollment / end-user impact before broad rollout — pilot-first; re-enrollment behavior verified against current Microsoft/Google guidance, not assumed.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (integration active, accounts add, existing devices behave as expected) plus Best Practices; enrollment-impact claims flagged to verify in your tenant.
short: Integrate Google Workspace / Cloud Identity with Intune as third-party EMM for managed Google Play — the Google Admin console + Intune configuration, the identity model, and a clear read on re-enrollment / end-user impact — so you enable it confidently. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
